note: Canonical Birdy inventory. Single source of truth for the offline Python pipeline (corpus rendering, galaxy) and the browser syrinx engine. Contours are [timeFraction, Hz]. Functions marked confidence=experimental are backed by playback experiments; documented = described in the literature; inferred = plausible but not experimentally established.  Extended with syllable types fitted to field recordings: their ids start with `L`, they carry the cosine between their resynthesis and the audio they came from, and none of them has a documented function.
